title: RC-Inspect: code, split lists, cached predictions and results
description: Code, leakage-safe split lists with SHA-256 hashes, cached detector predictions and result files for the paper 'RC-Inspect: A lightweight risk-controlled deep learning framework for real-time defect inspection in steel and electronic manufacturing' (submitted to Computers and Electrical Engineering). Code under the MIT licence; split lists, predictions and results under CC BY 4.0. Dataset images and annotations are not included.
